morphology.pattern_note: 拟声词根，无词缀；词末 k 实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。常以重叠形式 tok-tok 使用。音节为补全值；以下词族包含重叠词和复合词。

word_family.gloss: 笃笃声；木制敲击传讯器
以敲击竹片声招徕顾客的小贩所售的面

senses.zh_definition: 竹片或类似物体相互敲击所发出的“笃笃”声，通常用重叠形式 tok-tok。
senses.en_definition: A sharp knocking or clacking sound, especially that made by striking pieces of bamboo together; usually tok-tok.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi seperti bunyi pukulan dua keping buluh, lazimnya disebut tok-tok.
senses.nuances: 本词条依词包收录拟声义；不要直接套用称呼祖辈或长者的同形 tok。mi tok-tok 是带传统小贩文化色彩的固定搭配，不是当代普遍使用的面类总称。[DBP：tok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=tok)

collocations.en: noodles hawked to the sound of bamboo clappers

senses.zh_definition: 通常作 tok-tok：敲击发声以召集人群或传讯的木制器具，同 tong-tong。
senses.en_definition: Usually tok-tok: a wooden signalling instrument struck to summon people; a tong-tong.
senses.ms_definition: Tong-tong, iaitu alat kayu berongga yang diketuk untuk memanggil orang berkumpul.
senses.nuances: 这是词包中第二义 tong-tong 所指的器具义，须与第一义的声音区别；属于传统文化语境，搭配的现代使用频率有限。[DBP：tok 的第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=tok)；[tongtong 释义](https://educalingo.com/ms/dic-ms/tongtong)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran itu menerangkan bagaimana penjaja mi menggunakan bunyi tok-tok daripada pukulan dua keping buluh untuk menarik perhatian pelanggan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览介绍了卖面小贩如何通过敲击两片竹片发出的笃笃声吸引顾客。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition explains how noodle hawkers attracted customers with the clacking sound of two pieces of bamboo struck together.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dengar tak bunyi tok-tok kat luar tu?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah awak mendengar bunyi tok-tok di luar itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你听到外面那阵笃笃声了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Can you hear that clacking outside?
spoken_features: 疑问句省略 adakah 和可由语境补出的主语
tak 对应 tidak，置于动词后构成口语疑问
tok-tok 模拟反复敲击的声音

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dengar tak bunyi tok-tok kat luar tu? Bunyi apa?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak mendengar bunyi tok-tok di luar itu? Bunyi apakah itu?
messages.zh: 你听到外面笃笃的声音了吗？那是什么声？
messages.en: Can you hear that clacking outside? What is it?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Budak-budak tengah ketuk buluh je. Jom tengok.
messages.ms_standard: Kanak-kanak sedang mengetuk buluh sahaja. Mari kita lihat.
messages.zh: 就是几个小孩在敲竹片。走，看看去。
messages.en: It is just some kids tapping bamboo. Come on, let us have a look.

etymology.historical_story: Tok preserves a small piece of the traditional street soundscape. Kamus Dewan connects tok-tok with bamboo clacks made by noodle hawkers, and mi tok-tok names noodles sold with that audible signal. The association links a sound with a trade: customers could recognize what was being sold before seeing the hawker. [DBP: tok](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=tok)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 [toʔ] 听成短促的“笃”；重复 tok-tok，就像两片竹片“笃笃”相敲。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 拟声义本身没有敬语或贬义色彩。遇到 Tok 后接人名、亲属称呼或身份名称时，应先判断是否为另一个称谓用法。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述声音、传统小贩叫卖方式和民俗器物。讲述 mi tok-tok 时，可解释其声音来源，避免将传统职业与族群刻板印象联系起来。
